description: Free. Report a problem with Car Image itself (a failed or wrong render, an error that looks like a bug, a broken endpoint), with the human's agreement. Pass the failed call's request_id and what you know in context (endpoint, error_code, vehicle id, view, color): the team sees exactly what happened. Private to the human and the team. Similar open reports come back first, as with request_feature: upvote_feedback one that matches. The human gets an acknowledgement and an email when it is picked up and when it is fixed. Not for a vehicle the catalog lacks, and never include API keys.

body.description: What was called, what was expected, what happened.

context.description: The identifiers of what went wrong. Checked against the account's own requests; never shown publicly.

asset_id.description: The image asset id, when one was returned.

client.description: The host or client, e.g. Claude Code.

endpoint.description: The tool or path that failed, e.g. get_car_image or /api/v1/images/car.

error_code.description: The error code or status the call returned.

model_3d_id.description: The 3D request id, for a 3D model problem.

force.description: File it even though similar reports exist.

request_id.description: The request_id of the failed call (from its error or X-Request-Id). The single most useful thing to attach.

title.description: What went wrong, in a line, e.g. "Side views of the 2024 Camry return 502". No keys or personal data.

name: report_issue
title: Report an issue
